units.source_text: 那花散里虽然和源氏公子相会之日甚少，但因自己的清苦生涯全然托庇公子照拂，所以她的悲叹也是理之当然。

en.t: Although Hanachirusato had very few days when she could meet Prince Genji, her meager life depended entirely on his care, so her grief was only natural.

units.source_text: 此外与源氏公子偶有一面之缘的，或者曾有往来的女子，暗中伤心的人不可胜数。

en.t: Besides her, countless women who had once met Prince Genji by chance, or who had formerly had some connection with him, grieved in secret.
